case_title: YASHODHAN SINGH & ORS. v. THE STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH & ANR.
neutral_facts: The complainant, Respondent No.2, registered an FIR against the appellants alleging that they went to his house and started hurling abuses and firing, which resulted in his injuries and the death of his two brothers. A charge sheet was filed against the accused persons, but the names of the appellants were not mentioned in it as their role was under investigation. The complainant filed an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C. to summon the appellants, and the Additional Sessions Judge passed an order summoning them to join the trial. The appellants challenged the order in the High Court, which affirmed the order. The case involves the legal interpretation of Section 319 Cr.P.C. regarding the summoning of accused persons and the necessity of providing an opportunity of hearing before adding them to the trial.
